name: carplay_tilt_1807
what: carplay_tilt (see tilt_1703.json) for HMI ID5_1807-490-1809H Build 29 (NBTevo_ID5_1807_Release, HmiMain3D sha256 5e74cde5...; BMW F11 NBT Evo retrofit, 6WB cluster, ghackt/Carplay-advanced-installer issue #2). CCarPlayActivity::handleControllerInput is 006_017_006's code moved by 0x2f28 (the trace branch at tC by 0x2f40); as in 1903 the compiler keeps "pressed" in r7 (006 / 1703: r8), so the two words that store it use r7.
how: 0x4403bc..0x4403c4: the key filter becomes 9..14 (bhi to the same exit 0x44064c)
0x4405b0: tilt left no longer sets the Back field
0x44055c..0x44058c: zero the four direction words, store "pressed" (r7) in the one of key-9, Voice field (moveq r5, r7) as before, b 0x4405fc (the send call, bl 0x1fd9fe4)
0x4405d8: b 0x44055c instead of the original argument setup
Found by the installer's HMI scan (tA, tB, tC windows; the pressed register taken from moveq r5, r7 at tB+0x84) and checked instruction by instruction against the stock file and against 006_017_006.
